selection: 0.5 original Val mean(Single,Double,background) + 0.5 mean of the same group-balanced score over five noisy conditions; tie original overall ACC. Select one trained checkpoint per arm. Test only after all selections are sealed.
training: All trainable classifiers start from the same random TabM initialization, with no prior task checkpoint or external pretrained weights. G1/G2 share identical interaction initialization and parameter counts. Equal updates and identical online waveform views; joint Val-only early stop. Each member has its own CE and marginal-count loss.
prediction: Average member softmax probabilities, then choose the seven-set argmax. Final count is the chosen set's cardinality. Marginal count probabilities are reported but never hard-route the set prediction.
